critiques.text: Make his base hair color #362926.
critiques.note: Set the hair and beard base to #362926 and shifted the highlight (#5e4134) and shadow (#221a1b) to match, so the shading still reads.

critiques.text: Make his shoulders wider, his hands look goofy
critiques.note: Widened the chest to 24px with bigger shoulder caps set further out (about 32px across) and redrew the hands as rounded, shaded fists the width of the wrist.

critiques.text: The side walk looks super strange, give him some bend in his arms and knees when he walks.
critiques.note: Redrew the side walk with bent knees (heel strike, toe push-off, and a passing leg lifted with the knee forward), elbows bent and swinging opposite the legs, and the far arm showing behind the body.

critiques.text: his walk up and down look strange, change them to be more similar to his side walk which has a lot more detail.
critiques.note: Rebuilt the front and back walks like the side walk: the planted leg takes the weight while the trailing heel lifts, the passing leg rises with a bent, creased knee, and the elbows bend and swing opposite the legs (mirrored for the back view).

critiques.text: his hand disapears
critiques.note: Fixed the back-swing hand being clipped at the edge of its layer, so the fist is drawn whole, and moved it onto whole pixels as a full 5px fist with lighter shading.

critiques.text: His arms are way to small rn, make them the size of the side walk and walk down
critiques.note: Replaced the thin idle arms (front, back and side) with the same thick, hanging arms the walks use, so idle and walk match.

critiques.text: his hand should be infront of his body when it swings
critiques.note: In the walk away from the camera the arms are now drawn behind the torso, so the forward-swinging hand passes in front of his body (hidden by his back) instead of over it.

critiques.text: Can you make him relatively the same size as titus, but a little bit shorter. Right now the dimensions look really weird specifically the neck
critiques.note: Matched Mason's build more closely to Titus, kept him three pixels shorter, and closed the neck gap in every direction.

critiques.text: Hey he is short and fat, base him off of how Titus was built, but keep the core aspects of how Mason is supposed to be different
critiques.note: Rebuilt Mason on Titus proportions with longer legs and a slimmer torso, retaining the cowboy hat, sunglasses, tactical gear, and Russian flag patch.

critiques.text: Ok so that is a little better., the torso is still too fat, and the head is too low. It looks like his head is being smashed into his body and he doesn't have a neck.
critiques.note: Narrowed the torso and shoulders, raised the head three pixels, and added a visible neck in all views and idle frames.

critiques.text: could you make his legs a little skinnier so they aren't so blocky. I want him to actually look fast
critiques.note: Slimmed the trouser legs and boots in every idle and walking view while preserving the bent-knee stride and planted feet.

critiques.text: Can you give him absolutely chiseled abs
critiques.note: Opened the tactical vest to show deeply shaded, chiseled abs with matching muscle definition in the side view.

critiques.text: the abs needs to be under the shirt, and he still needs to have pecs
critiques.note: Covered the torso with a fitted black shirt and shaded broad pecs and a narrower six-pack through the fabric.

critiques.text: Ok so Mason's neck doesn't look right at all. It should be aligned with his torso. Right now it is too far forward and looks really unnatural from the side.
critiques.note: Centered the side-view neck above the torso and lowered the shoulder tops so the neck stays visible in idle and walking frames.

critiques.text: The left side of the bathroom looks good, but the right side still needs a entry from the other side coming up from the south side. You can mirror this edit to the other bathroom on the east side.
critiques.note: Added south-facing entrances to both bathrooms, moved the noticeboards beside the openings, and verified entry and exit through both doors.

critiques.text: remove the wood panels
critiques.note: Removed the wooden door frame (jambs and sill) from that doorway so it opens straight onto the hall.

critiques.text: this corner (and others like it) look strange, fix them all.
critiques.note: Added outlined wall-top tiles where a wall meets a brick face and swapped them in at all 110 junctions, so each wall's outline runs up to the top of the brick wall.

critiques.text: turn these sideways for the room. people don't point dressers toward walls
critiques.note: Added a sideways wardrobe prop (wardrobe_side, east/west) and turned all 64 wardrobes so their doors face into their room, each still flush against its wall.

critiques.text: remove the giant head peice
critiques.note: Removed the tall headboard from the north-facing bed, so it now starts at the pillow (all colour variants follow).

critiques.text: the lines make it look goofy, and they don't have handles on the sides. it's very much just like a wood square
critiques.note: Redrew the sideways wardrobe as a plain wood box (no door lines or handles); east and west now share the same frame.

critiques.text: add a little wood to the top, just a little
critiques.note: Added a short 4px wooden headboard above the pillow on the north-facing bed, styled like the footboard.

critiques.text: I like this bed, make all the other bed's like it, the south beds ought to have a similar base except near the head bc of the perspective change. doulb check your work.
critiques.note: Rebuilt the south-facing bed on the north bed's frame (small wood strip at the foot, front panel at the head), so every bed and colour variant now matches.

critiques.text: remove the props from the top of the desks
critiques.note: Removed the lamp and book stack from every desk, so all four states now show a bare desktop.

critiques.text: the desks only have drawers on the right side, just have a leg here.
critiques.note: Replaced the left drawer pedestal with a single shaded leg on both views; drawers stay on the right only.

critiques.text: he's not a woman, make his chest a little less prominent
critiques.note: Flattened Titus's side-view chest to a 1px step so the torso reads straight from shoulder to waist in idle, walk and punch.

critiques.text: move the chair under the desk
critiques.note: Tucked the chair under the desk: on the front view it now sits in the kneehole, and on the back view it slides in behind the desktop.

critiques.text: Shrink in the left leg the chair the inside is about as wide as the chair.
critiques.note: Moved the left leg in to x 9-13 so the kneehole is just the chair's width plus 2px each side, on both views; the desktop keeps its full width.

critiques.text: the back actually looks horrible. flip it around people don't face the fall when they work at a desk.
critiques.note: Redrew the back view as the desk seen from behind: plain pedestal back on the left, a recessed modesty panel, and the leg on the right, with the chair facing the camera.

critiques.text: Remove the hanging chunk of desk
critiques.note: Undone at your request: the back view is back to the full desktop slab from #28.

critiques.text: Remove this hanging chunk of desk.
critiques.note: Trimmed the desktop so it ends at the leg on the front view (and at the matching edge on the back), so nothing overhangs; the footprint now covers just the desk.

critiques.text: The wall should be on the other side, it should kinda just look like a slab in the back. test your work to make sure it actually looks good.
critiques.note: Rebuilt the back view as a solid slab from behind with the drawer side on the right, matching the front's outline, and checked it in brock3.

critiques.text: Ok so the bathroom entrances are actually in reality reversed. They currently should have the top door on the east side of the top and the bottom door should be on the west side.
critiques.note: Moved the north entrance to the east and the south entrance to the west, closed the old openings, and checked the rendered level.

critiques.text: Ok same thing with this bathroom, the top entrance should be on the west side and the bottom entrance should be on the east side. Also I have to pictures of what the bathroom should actually look like on the inside.
critiques.note: Corrected the entrances and rebuilt both mirrored bathroom interiors from the photos, with six central showers, cream toilet stalls, urinals, sinks, and gray tile; checked the renders and player routes.

critiques.text: OK hold up lets just focus on the left side right now. Between the stairs and the doorway are the two stalls and the 2 urinals, then the door/ entrance. The sinks are on the south side wall and there is 4. You can delete the sinks you have behind and infront of the showers because those don't belong there. Then you can push the showers back against the wall so that they aren't in the middle
critiques.note: Refined only the marked east bathroom: two stalls then two urinals then the north entrance, four sinks on the south wall, and six showers against the north and south walls; checked the render and both entrance routes.

critiques.text: OK so we need to squish the stalls closer to the wall and the urinals. The sinks also need to be a different size and upagainst the wall. The top door needs to be closer to the left and there also is a little wall the comes accross infront of the door as you come in that makes an backwards L so you can't see into the shower area
critiques.note: Packed two narrower stalls and two urinals against the stairwell end, resized the four sinks to 24px counters flush with the south wall, shifted the north entrance west, and added a backward-L privacy screen with a verified walkable route.

critiques.text: Ok so now the left side looks good, the right side now needs to mirror the left side, but with the perspective from the south obviously. Ask me any clarifying questions if needed
critiques.note: Mirrored the approved left half into the right half with south-facing stalls and urinals, four north-wall sinks, and a rotated privacy screen at the south entrance; retained six wall-backed showers and verified the player route.

critiques.text: ok theL wall needs to be shorter, and not take up so much space. The middle of the bathroom should have the 6 showers facing each other and should have a central space in the bathroom
critiques.note: Shortened both L screens to two-tile returns and placed all six showers in two facing rows in the middle with a 32px central aisle; verified both entrances remain walkable.

critiques.text: OK I think we are going to need to expand the bathroom to have the showers sit against the wall flat. I think we need to expand it over about 3 tiles to the left and make the stair room smaller so we can fit the bathroom the way I want it
critiques.note: Expanded the bathroom three tiles west, narrowed and refit the stair room, shifted the left fixtures and entrance west, and placed the six facing showers flat against the north and south walls with an open central floor; checked the render and player routes.

critiques.text: Ok I think we might reduce the amount of shower stalls to two so that the fomatting looks better. There also is a short wall between the sinks and the showers
critiques.note: Reduced the showers to two per wall (four total), widened the cubicles, and added a short divider between each sink counter and shower area; checked the render and both entrance routes.

critiques.text: Actually if you shift the short wall over one tile we can fit a third shower on each side
critiques.note: Moved both short sink dividers one tile toward the sinks and restored three full-width showers on each wall, retaining the open center and verified entrance routes.

critiques.text: Ok can you mirror exacly what you did with the east bathrooms and make the interior the same as on this one, but keep the top entrance on the middle right, and the bottom entrance in the middle left
critiques.note: Mirrored the finished east bathroom fixtures, showers, sink dividers, and privacy screens into the west bathroom, with its top entrance in the middle-right and bottom entrance in the middle-left; checked matching layouts and player routes.
